title: From English-Centric to Effective Bilingual: LLMs with Custom Tokenizers for Underrepresented Languages
reasoning: The paper introduces and evaluates several new metrics for language quality in LLMs, such as the Code Switching Word Ratio and Grammar Correctness Score. While it addresses 'fairness' in the context of linguistic representation and reducing the computational cost for non-English speakers, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
